# ACP Lending

> Investment-property financing for real estate investors. ACP Lending originates,
> underwrites, and structures financing directly with institutional capital partners.
> Business-purpose lending only; not a consumer mortgage lender.

Contact: Steve Waller - 936-522-8951 - steve@acp-lending.com
Website: https://acp-lending.com/
Service area: United States, with Texas-specific programs

## Financing programs

- [Fix-and-Flip Bridge Loans](https://acp-lending.com/fix-and-flip-bridge-loans): Up to 100%
  of purchase and 100% of renovation, capped by the lower of loan-to-cost and 65% to 80% of
  after-repair value depending on program, credit and experience. Rates from 9.99% with 1% to 3%
  in points, 6-24 month interest-only terms, $50,000 to $5,000,000. 600 minimum credit on some
  programs, 640-650 on most. 100% programs: 650+ credit capped at 65% of ARV (70% at 700+, 75% at
  700+ with 3 completed flips, loans to $1,250,000); 720+ credit with 10+ flips (5 in state) capped
  at 75% of ARV, loans to $800,000. Closing costs are paid at closing. Individual and LLC borrowers.
- [Texas Hard Money Fix and Flip Loans: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin](https://acp-lending.com/texas-fix-and-flip-loans): The fix-and-flip
  terms above for Texas properties statewide (Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin),
  also available in most other states,
  with answers on 100% financing, cash to close, credit score and first flips.
- [100% Fix and Flip Financing](https://acp-lending.com/100-percent-fix-and-flip-financing): What
  100% financing covers (purchase and renovation), what the borrower still pays (points, lender
  fees, prepaid interest, title, insurance), and who qualifies.
- [Texas Hard Money and Bridge Loans: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin](https://acp-lending.com/texas-bridge-loans): Short-term investor bridge
  loans in Texas, and most other states, for purchase, renovation, and refinance of a maturing or matured hard money loan.
- [Texas DSCR Loans: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin](https://acp-lending.com/texas-dscr-loans): Texas rental loans qualified on rent,
  no tax returns, also available in most other states. 30-year fixed, up to 80% LTV purchase, 75% cash-out, no minimum DSCR on some
  programs, from about 7.75%.
- [Texas Hard Money Construction Loans: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin](https://acp-lending.com/texas-ground-up-construction-loans):
  Texas spec, infill and build-to-rent construction loans, up to 85% of cost and 70% of completed
  value, 9% to 12%, interest only on drawn funds. Also available in most other states.
- [DSCR Rental Loans](https://acp-lending.com/dscr-rental-loans): Qualification on property
  cash flow rather than personal income. 30-year fixed, 5/1 ARM and 7/1 ARM, with
  interest-only structures. Purchase, rate-and-term refinance and cash-out refinance.
  Leverage up to 80% LTV on purchase and rate-and-term; cash-out refinances are typically
  capped lower, generally around 75%. DSCR requirements as low as 0.80x on certain programs. A Flexible Credit DSCR program
  (30-year fixed, $50,000-$2,000,000) has no minimum credit score and no minimum DSCR, up to 75% LTV
  on purchases (70% for first-time investors); refinances 75% LTV at 675+, 70% at 650-674, 65% at 600-649, 60% under 600; vacant properties qualify on market rent.
- [Ground-Up Construction Loans](https://acp-lending.com/ground-up-construction-loans): Loan
  amounts generally $100,000 to $10 million. Interest-only on funds actually drawn.
  Milestone-based draws verified by inspection. Up to 85% of total project cost and up to
  70% of completed value. Single-family spec homes, infill construction, build-to-rent, and
  certain 2-4 unit residential projects.
- [Multifamily Loans](https://acp-lending.com/multifamily-loans): 5+ units. Short-term bridge
  from $250,000 to $2,000,000 on 12-18 month terms with extensions available, up to 75% LTV
  purchase (70% for first-time investors) / 70% refinance / 65% cash-out, with a value-add variant to 80% of purchase price
  plus 100% of rehab for experienced sponsors. Long-term financing for stabilized 5-9 unit
  properties from $150,000 to $1,500,000 on a 30-year term, up to 70% LTV purchase and
  refinance, 65% cash-out, with a higher minimum credit score.
- [Portfolio Loans](https://acp-lending.com/portfolio-loans): $2 million to $75 million or
  more. Portfolios of 20 to 100+ units, scattered-site and multi-state accepted. Blends 1-4
  unit rentals and 5-9 unit multifamily in a single facility. Up to 70% LTV tiered by credit
  score. 5, 7 or 10-year terms with 30-year amortization or interest-only. Non-recourse
  structure available. Portfolios generally need to be at least 90% leased.
- [Commercial Real Estate Loans](https://acp-lending.com/commercial-real-estate-loans): 30-year fixed, no balloon,
  for assisted living homes (1-4 units, $50,000-$2,000,000 up to 75% LTV on purchases (70% for first-time investors); up to $10,000,000 at 65% LTV with 600+ credit for
  experienced investors in major metros), 5+ unit and mixed-use from $100,000 up to 75% LTV on purchases (70% for first-time investors). Property types include office, retail, warehouse, self-storage and automotive. No minimum
  credit score on certain programs.
- [Commercial Bridge Loans](https://acp-lending.com/commercial-bridge-loans): $500,000 to $5,000,000, 12 to 36 months, interest only, no prepayment penalty, up to 65% LTV, first lien, for office, warehouse, retail, self-storage and light industrial property in Texas, Florida, Oklahoma, New Mexico and Arkansas.

## Tools and resources

- [Deal Calculator](https://acp-lending.com/deal-calculator): Flip underwriting calculator
  plus a flip-versus-rent exit comparison (refinance proceeds, NOI, DSCR, cash flow).
  Includes a Texas HML advance option that sizes the loan on after-repair value alone.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://acp-lending.com/dscr-calculator): Debt-service coverage calculator
  for rental-property financing. Returns LTV, NOI, payment, PITIA, lender DSCR (rent divided by
  PITIA) and a stricter NOI-based DSCR, plus monthly cash flow.
- [Pre-Approval Request](https://acp-lending.com/pre-approval): Conditional pre-approval
  letter for use with offers.
- [Request for Information](https://acp-lending.com/request-financing): Submit a deal
  for review or ask about a program.
- [Loan Forms](https://acp-lending.com/loan-documents): Every form needed to prepare and return a financing request
- [Investor Guidance](https://acp-lending.com/investor-resources): How ARV, leverage, DSCR and borrower contribution are evaluated
- [ACP Investor Brief](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/): Investor guides on DSCR
- [Choosing Your Strategy and Your Market](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/choosing-your-strategy-and-market): Sep 2026 guide — three investor strategies ranked by current data, running a deal from both a lending and a profitability position, the six costs that decide every project, lender structure that preserves liquidity, and Texas vs. out-of-state market conditions.
- [Why Are More Homes Sitting on the Market?](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/why-homes-are-sitting-on-the-market): Sep 2026 guide — why inventory is rising on slower absorption rather than more listings, and where investor deals come from.
- [$17K out of pocket on an $889K fix-and-flip loan](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/north-texas-100-percent-financing-case-study): Nov 2026 fix-and-flip case study. A north Texas suburb flip where the loan covers 100% of the purchase and 100% of the renovation, with about $17,400 cash at closing.
- [Whose Repair Number? Borrower Budget vs. Third-Party Estimate](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/repair-estimate-case-study): Oct 2026 fix-and-flip case study — a borrower repair budget of $70,000 against a $98,500 third-party-priced estimate from the same photos; how the gap moves cash required, liquidity and the supportable offer, why lenders size repairs at third-party cost, and how unused repair funds are returned at payoff.
- [Four Doors, One Hidden Coverage Problem](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/dscr-four-condo-case-study): Sep 2026 DSCR case study — a four-condo package where HOA dues and taxes consume 43% of stabilized rent, producing a 0.81 DSCR at current occupancy and 1.15 stabilized. Full PITIA and NOI math, coverage by down payment, and the condo-specific items to verify before financing. Two-page PDF at /investor-brief/acp-dscr-four-condo-case-study.pdf
- [ACP Investor Brief — Daily](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/daily/): Auto-published market updates, Monday, Wednesday and Friday plus a Sunday recap. RSS at /investor-brief/daily/feed.xml
  versus bridge financing, how construction draws work, and how a deal is underwritten,
  plus dated market updates on rates, permits, starts, construction costs and inflation as
  they affect investment-property financing.

## Terms of use for this information

All figures above are program maximums, not offers. Financing is subject to underwriting,
lender approval, appraisal or valuation, title, insurance, property eligibility and program
availability. Preliminary analyses are not commitments to lend. Starting rates move with the
market and are updated weekly at https://acp-lending.com/rates - contact ACP Lending for a quote.
